//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the KPI SPARKLINE-LIST CONTAINER — the `.pa-kpi-spark-list` block, a `.pa-card` namespaced as a sparkline-list host (keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiSparklineList.kpi_sparkline_list/1`, svelte `display/KpiSparklineList.svelte`). The card is a container-query host whose body holds one `.pa-kpi-spark-row` per KPI (label · sparkline · value · Δ%). SCOPE = the container card chrome the component EMITS INLINE (header with the canonical card title + the `.pa-kpi-live` pill, the `.pa-card__body pa-kpi-spark-list__body` region, the `.pa-card__footer pa-kpi-footer`) + the two BLOCK modifiers `--no-delta` / `--chart-first`. The ROWS are a SEPARATE sub-component (svelte `KpiSparklineRow`, keen `kpi_sparkline_row/1`) fed through the body slot; both dumpers pass slot content as plain escaped TEXT, so the per-row `.pa-kpi-spark-row*` element + sentiment classes (incl. the inline SVG sparkline, the __num/__unit value split, the __delta--* tints and the __chart sentiment --up/--down tints) CANNOT materialize here and have no row-fragment fixture/dumper wiring — they are DEFERRED as acknowledged prose (same model as stacked-bar.json / accent-grid.json / dot-leaders.json defer their row sub-components, while table-card.json is the precedent for a header/body/footer-bearing CARD container that scopes the chrome it emits inline and defers the slot's rich child). The harness slot carries a plain text token (Body) so the diff proves the card tag + its classes + block modifiers + the header/body/footer nesting, not rich row content. TITLE SHAPE: the blessed title is the CANONICAL card title — `.pa-card__title` > `.pa-card__title-text` (snippets/kpi.html L333, matching the card-header canonicalization rule: never a bare <h3>), NOT a bare heading. svelte already emits this; keen was fixed to match (it previously emitted a bare <h3>, diverging from both the snippet and its own canonical card title shape).

propsVocabulary.title: header title text — rendered inside the canonical `.pa-card__title` > `.pa-card__title-text` shape (snippets/kpi.html L333). svelte titleText; keen title_text.
propsVocabulary.live: show the animated LIVE pill (`.pa-kpi-live` + `.pa-kpi-live__dot` + the text 'LIVE') next to the title. svelte isLive (hardcodes 'LIVE'); keen is_live (live_text defaults to 'LIVE').
propsVocabulary.footer: footer caption text — wrapped in `.pa-card__footer pa-kpi-footer` as a <span>. svelte footerText; keen footer_text.
propsVocabulary.noDelta: pa-kpi-spark-list--no-delta — drops the trailing Δ% column from every row's grid. svelte noDelta; keen is_no_delta.
propsVocabulary.chartFirst: pa-kpi-spark-list--chart-first — rotates the mid-narrow row layout to label-on-top / chart-middle / value+delta-bottom. svelte isChartFirst; keen is_chart_first.
propsVocabulary.body: the row area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (the real `.pa-kpi-spark-row` children are the deferred row sub-component, rendered by KpiSparklineRow / kpi_sparkline_row which both dumpers can't flow through a text slot). svelte children; keen inner_block.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature.

goldenConventions: Structural container card. The header renders ONLY when title or live is present; the body wrapper (`.pa-card__body pa-kpi-spark-list__body`) ALWAYS renders; the footer renders ONLY when footer text is present. The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the card's tag + classes + block modifiers + the header/body/footer nesting, not rich row content. The title is the canonical `.pa-card__title` > `.pa-card__title-text` shape (blessed). The LIVE pill text is the literal 'LIVE'. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-spark-list'). The .pa-kpi-spark-list BLOCK has exactly TWO modifiers — --no-delta and --chart-first — plus the __body element class on the card body. Every other pa-kpi-spark-* class (the whole pa-kpi-spark-row* family: __label/__chart/__value/__num/__unit/__delta[--*] + the row sentiment modifiers --up/--up-strong/--flat/--down/--down-strong, plus the JS-generated pa-kpi-spark-wrap/pa-kpi-spark-dot) belongs to the ROW sub-component (deferred prose). title/live/footer are structural chrome this container emits inline using shared card + kpi-base classes (pa-card__title/__title-text, pa-kpi-live, pa-card__footer/pa-kpi-footer) — they carry no pa-kpi-spark-list--* block modifier, so produces:null. capability.mjs axis-1 reverse-check is scoped to the pa-kpi-spark-list--* block modifiers (--no-delta, --chart-first).

title.note: structural — canonical .pa-card__title > .pa-card__title-text (blessed shape, NOT a bare <h3>)

live.note: structural — emits the .pa-kpi-live pill (shared kpi-base class, not a block modifier)

footer.note: structural — footer caption wrapped in .pa-card__footer pa-kpi-footer

body.note: structural — the card body (.pa-card__body pa-kpi-spark-list__body); the real .pa-kpi-spark-row children are the deferred row sub-component

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: The entire pa-kpi-spark-row* family — NOT container markup. Owned by the ROW sub-component (svelte KpiSparklineRow, keen kpi_sparkline_row/1), which both dumpers pass as plain escaped text through the container's body slot and so cannot render here. There is NO row-fragment fixture (neither wrapper registers one for kpi-sparkline-row), so these are ACKNOWLEDGED PROSE deferrals (reported, not verified against another fixture). The sentiment row modifiers (--up/--up-strong/--flat/--down/--down-strong) tint the chart via currentColor; the __delta--* tints colour the Δ% cell; pa-kpi-spark-wrap/pa-kpi-spark-dot are JS-generated at init (the SVG endpoint <circle> is swapped for a positioned CSS span — never SSR-authored).
deferred.pa-kpi-spark-row: one KPI row — owned by the KpiSparklineRow / kpi_sparkline_row sub-component (slot child), not the container
deferred.pa-kpi-spark-row--up: row sentiment modifier — tints the chart line/area/dot via currentColor (--pa-positive); row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-spark-row__label: row element — uppercase metric name; row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-spark-row__chart: row element — positioned sparkline wrapper (anchors the dot); row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-spark-row__value: row element — focal value cell; row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-spark-row__num: row element — numeric portion of the value; row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-spark-row__unit: row element — unit/prefix suffix of the value; row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-spark-row__delta: row element — Δ% cell; row sub-component
deferred.pa-kpi-spark-wrap: JS-generated positioned wrapper inserted around an SVG sparkline at init — never SSR-authored
deferred.pa-kpi-spark-dot: JS-generated CSS span replacing the SVG endpoint <circle> at init — never SSR-authored
